children: Coronado Global Resources mixed the good with the bad in its latest quarter. Coronado's Curragh mine in Australia achieved its strongest quarter for run-of-mine coal production since 2020, says Jefferies. That lifted 3Q Ebitda to US$44 million. However, Coronado cut its annual production target and raised estimates for mining costs on setbacks at its U.S. and Australian mines. It cited "recent Buchanan geology issues, slower than expected Mammoth ramp-up and CHPP throughput, as well as unfavorable FX and diesel cost year-to-date." Analyst Daniel Roden says Coronado needs to demonstrate better processing and underground execution. Jefferies stays at hold. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
